about_the_game:
Run, jump, and climb your way through deadly outposts in search of magical rubies!
Outpost Legends is a fast-paced platformer where precise movement and quick reflexes are key. Dodge spikes, leap over rotating saws, swing across ropes, and survive deep chasms — all while collecting shimmering rubies hidden throughout dangerous levels.

Your mission is to collect every ruby, overcome every obstacle, and reclaim the stolen magic of a fallen kingdom.

Long ago, powerful enchanted rubies brought prosperity to the land. But a ruthless mechanical tyrant seized them and locked them away inside his lethal strongholds. Now, only the most agile and determined hero can retrieve them and restore balance to the realm.

Key Features:

  • 🎨 Beautiful, hand-crafted pixel art levels

  • ⚔️ Tight, responsive controls for skill-based platforming

  • 💎 Collect hidden rubies while navigating trap-filled stages

  • ⚙️ Avoid spikes, saws, collapsing platforms, and more

  • 🧗 Advanced movement: rope climbing, wall jumps, air control

  • 🏆 Increasingly difficult levels that reward mastery

Will you overcome the fortress of steel and shadow?
Your journey begins now — become the legend this kingdom needs.
